notes: Reallocated the 'such ... as' correlative: 'as' goes to the written relative אֲשֶׁר (it introduces the relative clause), and 'such' is the one-word rendering of כְּ + הַהוּא, fused under rule 30 and headed on כְּ. The previous allocation (כְּ → 'as', הוּא → 'such', אֲשֶׁר unrepresented) left a present relative morpheme unrendered while the word that introduces its clause went to the preposition.
